sources.note: Sec. 4 'Bainapi' (p.11): 'At Makapa it is called Turumasa, at Pikiwa Bainapi, and at Bamustu.. Dibiasu.' Sec. 4.3 (p.13): 'Vowels seem to be lengthened when they occur in stressed syllables, stress being probably phonemic.' This describes Bainapi = Dibiyaso (dibi1240); the 2002 SIL survey (per Tupper 2007) established Turumsa as a separate language, so this is NOT a statement about turu1250.
